purpose: Reconstruct each playable hero's normal job tree from explicit JobConnection predecessor edges and ordered JobLevel references without inferring topology from names or numeric ID patterns.

fieldEvidence.jobConnectionInfo: dump.cs explicitly defines JobLevels_IDFieldNumber=7, UISortFieldNumber=9 and PreJobConnectionListFieldNumber=23. The runtime also exposes m_nextJobConnectionInfos and m_preJobConnectionInfos, supporting graph interpretation of the predecessor list.
fieldEvidence.jobLevelInfo: dump.cs explicitly defines ConfigDataJobLevelInfo.IDFieldNumber=2, rank_codeFieldNumber=5, JobLevelUpHeroLevelFieldNumber=8, GotSkill_IDFieldNumber=28 and GotSoldier_IDFieldNumber=29.
fieldEvidence.ordering: JobLevels_ID is preserved in source list order. JobLevel ID magnitude and rank_code are not used to invent progression order.

normalizationRules: Consume only Stage 4-2 PASS or REVIEW hero-job output.
Use JobConnection IDs, never job display names, as graph node identities.
Use PreJobConnectionList as the only authoritative predecessor edge source.
Within one hero, classify predecessor IDs that belong to that hero as local edges.
If a predecessor exists globally but is outside the hero's Stage 4-2 connection set, preserve it as externalPredecessorIds and mark the hero REVIEW instead of silently attaching it.
If a predecessor ID does not exist globally, mark FAIL.
Preserve JobLevels_ID order exactly and resolve every listed ID against ConfigDataJobLevelInfo.
Do not sort JobLevels_ID by ID, rank_code, hero-level requirement, skill ID, or wiki layout.
Use UISort only as a deterministic sibling/display tie-break after topology is known; never use UISort to create a parent-child edge.
Reject cycles in the local JobConnection graph.
Emit explicit rootConnectionIds, predecessor/child edges, ordered level records, topological display order and root-to-leaf branch paths.

UPSTREAM_BLOCKED: Stage 4-2 hero-job-links output is absent or has a status other than PASS/REVIEW.
SOURCE_BLOCKED: JobConnectionInfo or JobLevelInfo TextAsset is missing, structurally invalid, or has no usable m_bytes payload.
FAIL: A Stage 4-2 JobConnection is missing from JobConnectionInfo.
A PreJobConnectionList ID does not exist globally.
A referenced JobLevel ID does not exist in JobLevelInfo.
Duplicate JobConnection or JobLevel IDs exist.
The local predecessor graph contains a cycle.
Stage 4-2 jobLevelIds disagree with the current JobConnectionInfo source.
REVIEW: A predecessor exists globally but is outside that hero's Stage 4-2 connection set.
A hero has no fully resolved local root because all apparent roots depend on external predecessors.
A hero has disconnected local components; preserve all nodes but require representative validation before public display.
PASS: Every Stage 4-2 connection resolves, every JobLevel reference resolves, the graph is acyclic, and all hero trees have fully local roots with no unexplained disconnected components.

completionRule: Run npm run inspect:hero-job-trees after Stage 4-2. Emit hero-job-trees only when there are no hard relation errors.
nextStage: 4-4 attach skill acquisition to the verified JobLevel sequence using explicit GotSkill_ID and other verified skill relations.
